g.text: Rows are single units ordered by major class, subtype and peak z-score time; color scale is −2 to +4 z.

text.style: font-size: 6.45px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #56616f

g.text: Firing rates are smoothed and z-scored to each unit's −5-to-0-s baseline, then displayed from −1 to +5 s. The All panel includes major-class and subtype annotation strips, and horizontal rules mark every subtype

text.style: font-size: 6.45px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #56616f

g.text: boundary; M2, M1 and S1 retain the same subtype/peak-time sorting rule. The dashed white line marks cue onset. Regional panels are descriptive subsets of the same 1,346 units, not independent replicates.
